# Command bar (`command-bar`)

Mono prompt with suggestions and history.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createCommandBar` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/commandBar.d.ts`): `.mh-command-bar`: a mono prompt for commands. The input is an ARIA combobox: typing shows matching suggestions in a `__list` listbox (Arrow Down / Up pick, Tab completes, Enter takes the picked one or runs the text, Escape closes, then clears). With no suggestions shown, Arrow Up and Down walk through earlier commands, as in a shell.

```ts
export function createCommandBar(options: CommandBarOptions = {}): CommandBarHandle;

export interface CommandBarOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the input (default "Command"). */
  ariaLabel?: string;
  value?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  /** The prompt before the text (default `>`). */
  prompt?: string;
  name?: string;
  size?: InputSize;
  disabled?: boolean;
  suggestions?: CommandSuggestions;
  /** Most suggestions shown at once (default 8). */
  maxSuggestions?: number;
  /** Earlier commands, oldest first; Arrow Up and Down walk through them while no suggestions are shown. */
  history?: readonly string[];
  /** Most commands kept (default 50). */
  historySize?: number;
  /** Empties the input after a command is run (default true). */
  clearOnSubmit?: boolean;
  /** Opens the suggestions above the bar, for a bar at the bottom of the screen. */
  openUp?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the suggestion list (default "Suggestions"). */
  listLabel?: string;
  onInput?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Enter with non-blank text and no suggestion picked; the command goes into the history. */
  onSubmit?: (command: string) => void;
}

export interface CommandBarHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  list: HTMLUListElement;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setSuggestions(suggestions: CommandSuggestions | undefined): void;
  /** Earlier commands, oldest first. */
  getHistory(): string[];
  setHistory(history: readonly string[]): void;
  /** Runs the current text as Enter would. */
  submit(): void;
  focus(): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createCommandBar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const log = document.createElement('pre');

const bar = createCommandBar({
  placeholder: 'Type a command',
  suggestions: [
    { value: 'lights on', description: 'Turn on the lights in a room' },
    { value: 'lights off', description: 'Turn off the lights in a room' },
    { value: 'scene evening', description: 'Dim everything to warm white' },
    { value: 'status', description: 'Summary of the home' },
  ],
  history: ['status'],
  onSubmit: (command) => (log.textContent += `> ${command}\nok\n`),
});

document.body.append(log, bar.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { CommandBar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { CommandSuggestion } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const commands: CommandSuggestion[] = [
  { value: 'lights on', description: 'Turn on the lights in a room' },
  { value: 'lights off', description: 'Turn off the lights in a room' },
  { value: 'scene evening', description: 'Dim everything to warm white' },
  { value: 'status', description: 'Summary of the home' },
];

export function CommandBarExample() {
  const [log, setLog] = useState<string[]>([]);
  return (
    <>
      <pre>{log.map((command) => `> ${command}\nok\n`).join('')}</pre>
      <CommandBar
        placeholder="Type a command"
        suggestions={commands}
        defaultHistory={['status']}
        onSubmit={(command) => setLog((lines) => [...lines, command])}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```
